summary_en: IKUYO CO., LTD. announced its intention to launch a tender offer for all ordinary shares of Muraki Co., Ltd. (TSE Standard, Code 7477) at 3,000 yen per share, subject to specified preconditions. The offer has not yet commenced and will not begin immediately to comply with Muraki's takeover defense policy.
title_en: Notice Regarding Scheduled Commencement of Tender Offer for Muraki Co., Ltd. (Securities Code: 7477)
translation_en_brief:
IKUYO CO., LTD. announced on October 26, 2026, its intention to conduct a tender offer for all ordinary shares of Muraki Co., Ltd. (TSE Standard Market, Code 7477) at 3,000 yen per share, contingent on satisfaction of specified preconditions. IKUYO's board of directors has resolved to acquire Muraki shares through the tender offer, subject to these conditions being met or waived by IKUYO. The company also submitted a proposal letter to Muraki's board on the same date.

The tender offer has not yet commenced. IKUYO stated that immediate commencement would violate Muraki's takeover defense policy adopted on April 25, 2025, which could trigger countermeasures. Therefore, to respect that policy, IKUYO will not immediately launch the offer. If all or part of the preconditions are not satisfied by May 31, 2027, and IKUYO does not waive them and decide to proceed, or if satisfaction becomes difficult and IKUYO does not decide to waive them, IKUYO will withdraw the proposal and the tender offer under the terms announced will not be executed.

IKUYO is issuing this release ahead of Muraki's extraordinary shareholders' meeting scheduled for October 13, 2026 (the reference date for voting), to ensure shareholders are informed that a tender offer is contemplated. The offer price may be revised within the range disclosed before commencement, and even after commencement, the offer may be withdrawn or the price reduced. Muraki's board and its independent committee (established under the takeover defense policy) will have time to conduct thorough review, while Muraki shareholders receive early, transparent information to make informed decisions.
